title: Machine Learning Engineer, LLM Applications
text:
Brightwell Health builds clinical documentation tools used by 3,000 clinics. Our Applied AI team turns large language models into reliable product features.

Responsibilities
- Build retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines over clinical knowledge bases using embeddings and a vector database (pgvector, Pinecone).
- Fine-tune open models with PyTorch and Hugging Face Transformers, including LoRA adapters.
- Design LLM evaluation: offline evals, human review loops and regression suites.
- Ship model-backed services in Python with FastAPI; deploy with Docker on AWS (SageMaker for training jobs).
- Track experiments in MLflow and work with product on A/B testing.
- Practice prompt engineering and guardrails for safety-critical outputs.

Requirements
- 3+ years of experience in machine learning engineering.
- Fluency in Python, PyTorch and the modern LLM stack (LangChain or LlamaIndex a plus).
- Solid NLP fundamentals and statistics.
- MS or PhD in a quantitative field preferred.
- Must be authorized to work in the United States.
